jobs.name: Ningaloo Reef
jobs.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a new complete underwater landscape inspired by Ningaloo Reef, WA, Australia. A broad fringing reef with a distant whale shark moving through sunlit open water. Match the reference's intricate engraved 1960s/70s woodcut / screenprint style, natural anatomy, coherent underwater perspective, sculptural forms and atmospheric depth. The reference is style only; create this specific different environment. Landscape 4:3, full bleed opaque artwork, richly drawn foreground and receding scenery. Sunlight and flowing currents. Compose for a website background: broad calm water around the middle with detailed landscape framing the edges, important wildlife in the upper middle/right so responsive crops work. Use ONLY acid yellow #edff35, electric cobalt #1641ff and hot pink #ff148d and their halftones. No people, text, logos, borders, UI, collage, repeated wallpaper or separate cutout composition. Place-inspired illustration, not a literal photographic survey. Deliver one finished image.
